issue.title: test_facade_rehydrates_valid_tale_and_ordered_schema fails against sase-core 87ae2809: tale schema gained decisions.<id>.corrects
issue.description:
Proposed by sase-1jy.6 (note #1) while implementing epic sase-1jy; triaged and filed by the sase-1jy land agent.

`tests/test_plan_validate.py::test_facade_rehydrates_valid_tale_and_ordered_schema` fails deterministically in agent workspaces on master d289b664a6. `plan_frontmatter_schema("tale")` now returns `decisions.<id>.corrects` between `decisions.<id>.requested` and `decisions.<id>.answer`, but the test's expected field list does not include it. (pytest's positional diff also reports an extra `bead_id`; that is only the one-slot shift.)

Root cause: sase-core 87ae2809 ("feat(plan)!: allow memory decisions to default true via corrects quotes", 2026-10-11, agent 0zq, no bead) added `corrects` to the decision grammar, plus `correction` / `claim_not_found` provenances. It is marked BREAKING: older sase-core readers reject the new provenance strings on frozen plan-decision payloads. The workspace `.venv` builds `sase_core_rs` from the linked sase-core checkout, which already contains 87ae2809. sase's `sase-core-revision.txt` pin (792255d5) predates it, so CI built at the pin still passes, but the test will go red as soon as the pin moves. No sase-side code references `corrects` yet.

Fix: when moving the sase-core pin past 87ae2809, update the expected schema list in this test. Then check whether any sase Python surface (plan validate/render, decision sheets, TUI and Telegram decision UIs) needs to accept or render `corrects` and the new provenances.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Fails in isolation on every run with the workspace sase_core_rs built from linked sase-core at or after 87ae2809, and on the clean base sase-1jy.6 stashed back to; the expected list simply lacks the new decisions.<id>.corrects field.

issue.creation_reason: A deterministic plan-validate test failure proposed by sase-1jy.6 has no tracking bead; the sase-1jy land agent traced it to an unadopted sase-core grammar change that will turn CI red when the pin moves.

payload.entry: Already fixed upstream: 117f4cebbc (agent 0zq, landed on origin/master minutes before this bead was filed) adds decisions.<id>.corrects to the expected schema in tests/test_plan_validate.py and moves sase-core-revision.txt past 87ae2809. Verified: the node passes on master 117f4cebbc.
